name: Sawn timber
definition: Timber sawn to size for building and joinery, sold by length. Species, strength class, treatment and kiln drying are listed on the product.

name: Plywood
definition: board of thin wood veneers glued in cross-grained layers.

name: Building board
definition: manufactured sheet for building (chipboard, MDF, OSB, plasterboard, cement board), sold loose.

name: Decking board
definition: Profiled timber or composite board sold loose for building a deck.

name: Steel section
definition: steel bar, angle, channel, box or tube section sold by length for building and fabrication.

name: Aluminium section
definition: aluminium bar, angle, channel or tube section sold by length.

name: Cement
definition: powdered binder mixed with water and aggregate to make concrete or mortar (ready-mix bags included).

name: Concrete block
definition: moulded block of concrete for building walls.

name: Brick
definition: fired clay or concrete unit laid in mortar to build walls.

name: Aggregate
definition: Sand, gravel or ballast sold for concrete, mortar or a sub-base.

name: Paving slab
definition: flat slab of concrete or stone laid as a path, patio or drive surface.

name: Sett
definition: small dressed block of stone or concrete laid as paving.

name: Lawn edging
definition: strip or border of metal, plastic, timber or stone set along a lawn or bed edge.

name: Weed membrane
definition: permeable sheet laid under paving, gravel or mulch to suppress weeds.

name: Roofing sheet
definition: corrugated or profiled sheet of metal, bitumen, fibre cement or plastic laid as a roof or cladding.

name: Insulation
definition: roll, slab or board of thermal or acoustic insulating material for a building (acoustic panels included).

name: Flue pipe
definition: pipe that carries smoke and gases from a stove, boiler or fire to the outside.

name: Chimney liner
definition: flexible or rigid liner fitted inside a chimney.

name: Chimney pot
definition: pot or terminal set on top of a chimney stack.

name: Door
definition: door leaf or door set for a building opening, installed or not.

name: Window
definition: window frame and glazing unit for a building opening, installed or not.

name: Fence panel
definition: prefabricated panel of timber, metal or composite fixed between posts.

name: Gate
definition: hinged or sliding barrier for an opening in a fence or wall.

name: Fence post
definition: post set in the ground to carry fence panels, rails or wire.

name: Fence wire
definition: plain, barbed or high-tensile wire sold for fencing.

name: Stock netting
definition: woven or welded wire mesh sold for fencing animals in or out.

name: Electric fence energiser
definition: Unit that sends pulses of current along an electric fence. An energiser for farm or garden fencing is listed here.

name: Electric fence tape
definition: conductive tape, rope or polywire strung as an electric fence.

name: Electric fence insulator
definition: insulator that holds an electric-fence wire or tape on a post.

name: Wallpaper
definition: paper, vinyl or textile wall covering sold in rolls for hanging.

name: Plaster
definition: powdered plaster or skim coat mixed with water to finish walls and ceilings.

name: Wall tile
definition: tile made and rated for walls.

name: Floor tile
definition: Tile made and rated for floors, with its wear and slip rating.

name: Laminate flooring
definition: click-together boards with a printed decorative layer on a fibreboard core.

name: Skirting board
definition: moulded board that trims the base of a wall or the frame of a door or window.

name: Wood screw
definition: tapered, coarse-threaded screw for fixing into timber and boards.

name: Decking screw
definition: corrosion-resistant screw made to fix decking boards to joists.

name: Drywall screw
definition: fine- or coarse-threaded bugle-head screw for fixing plasterboard to studs.

name: Masonry screw
definition: hardened screw that cuts its own thread into a drilled hole in masonry or concrete.

name: Self-drilling screw
definition: screw with a drill point that drills and taps sheet metal in one pass.

name: Machine screw
definition: parallel-threaded screw for a tapped hole or a nut.

name: Nail
definition: plain steel pin with a head, driven by hammer or nail gun (loose or collated).

name: Concrete nail
definition: hardened nail made to be driven into concrete or masonry.

name: Staple
definition: U-shaped wire fastener driven by a stapler or tacker.

name: Bolt
definition: Threaded fastener with a head, used with a nut. Its strength is shown as a property class.

name: Nut
definition: internally threaded fastener that mates with a bolt or stud.

name: Washer
definition: flat or spring ring set under a nut or head to spread load or lock it.

name: Rivet
definition: fastener set by deforming its tail, including blind (pop) rivets.

name: Wall plug
definition: plastic or fibre sleeve that expands in a drilled hole to hold a screw.

name: Cavity fixing
definition: fixing that opens or grips behind a hollow wall or board.

name: Chemical anchor
definition: Resin cartridge or capsule that bonds a stud or bar into a drilled hole. Resin sold alone is listed here too.

name: Frame fixing
definition: long plug and screw that fix a frame through to masonry in one pass.

name: Steel anchor
definition: metal expansion anchor or anchor bolt for heavy fixings in concrete or masonry.

name: Timber connector
definition: pressed-steel plate, hanger or bracket that joins timber members.

name: Post support
definition: metal shoe, spike or base that holds a post in the ground or on a surface.

name: Dowel
definition: wooden, plastic or metal pin set into holes to join or align two parts.

name: Packer
definition: thin plate or wedge set under or behind a frame or fixing to level or space it.

name: Door hinge
definition: Hinge on which a door, gate or window leaf swings. Butt hinges and other patterns are all listed here.

name: Cabinet knob
definition: Knob or pull handle fitted to a cabinet door or drawer.

name: Door handle
definition: Lever, knob or pull handle set for a door, without a lock. A handle set with a lock is in Home Safety & Security.

name: Latch
definition: catch that holds a door or gate shut without a key.

name: Door bolt
definition: sliding bolt that secures a door or gate from one side.

name: Hasp
definition: hinged slotted plate and staple that take a padlock.

name: Bracket
definition: General bracket or shelf support fixed to a wall or structure. Brackets made for one screen or speaker are not here.

name: Letter plate
definition: Letter flap and plate fitted in a door.

name: Safety sign
definition: Sign that gives a safety, fire, hazard or legal instruction.

name: Compression fitting
definition: fitting that seals on a pipe by a nut squeezing an olive.

name: Push-fit fitting
definition: fitting that grips and seals a pipe pushed into it, with no tools or heat.

name: Solder-ring fitting
definition: copper fitting with an integral ring of solder, sealed by heating.

name: End-feed fitting
definition: copper fitting sealed by solder fed into the joint while heated.

name: Press-fit fitting
definition: fitting sealed by crimping onto the pipe with a press tool.

name: Plumbing pipe
definition: plumbing, heating, gas or water supply pipe of copper, plastic or steel, sold by length or coil.

name: Pipe clip
definition: clip or bracket that holds a pipe to a wall or joist.

name: Tap
definition: Hand-operated valve that delivers water at a basin, sink, bath or outside. Mixer taps are included.

name: Valve
definition: valve that shuts off or controls flow in a pipe (stop cock, isolating and radiator valves).

name: Waste fitting
definition: pipe and fitting for the waste outlet of a basin, sink or bath.

name: Trap
definition: water-sealed bend under an outlet that blocks drain gases.

name: Guttering
definition: gutter and downpipe sections and fittings that carry rainwater from a roof.

name: Shower tray
definition: Base set under a shower that collects the water and carries it to the waste.

name: Shower enclosure
definition: glass or panel walls and door around a shower.

name: Bath panel
definition: panel that covers the side or end of a bath.

name: Cable
definition: fixed-wiring mains cable (twin and earth and the like).

name: Flex
definition: flexible mains cord for connecting appliances and fittings.

name: Armoured cable
definition: mains cable with a steel-wire armour layer for burial or exposed runs.

name: Cable clip
definition: clip that fixes a cable to a wall or surface.

name: Wall switch
definition: wall switch for a mains circuit or light.

name: Wall socket
definition: Wall socket that takes mains plugs. Every plug type, A to O, is listed here.

name: Mains plug
definition: Rewireable or moulded plug for a mains flex. Every plug type, A to O, is listed here.

name: Fuse
definition: cartridge or rewireable fuse that breaks a circuit on overload.

name: Ceiling rose
definition: Ceiling fitting where a pendant flex joins the fixed wiring.

name: Extension lead
definition: flex with a mains plug and one or more sockets, on a reel or not.

name: Consumer unit
definition: fuse box or board that holds a building's breakers or fuses.

name: Wall and ceiling paint
definition: Interior paint for walls and ceilings, in any finish such as emulsion.

name: Masonry paint
definition: exterior paint for brick, render and masonry.

name: Fence paint
definition: paint or treatment for timber fences and sheds.

name: Floor paint
definition: hard-wearing paint for concrete, wood or garage floors.

name: Radiator paint
definition: heat-resistant paint for radiators and pipes.

name: Tile paint
definition: paint made to adhere to glazed tiles.

name: Furniture paint
definition: paint made for furniture and cabinets.

name: Woodwork and metal paint
definition: Gloss, satin or eggshell paint for doors, trim and metalwork.

name: Spray paint
definition: paint in an aerosol can.

name: Primer
definition: Preparatory coat that goes under the top coat: primer, undercoat, primer-undercoat or sealer.

name: Wood stain
definition: coloured finish that soaks into wood and shows its grain.

name: Varnish
definition: clear or tinted film-forming finish for wood.

name: Wood oil
definition: penetrating oil finish for wood (decking and furniture oils).

name: Wood wax
definition: wax finish rubbed into wood.

name: Sandpaper
definition: Abrasive sheet or roll for hand or general use, not cut to fit one sander.

name: Grab adhesive
definition: high-tack construction adhesive from a cartridge that holds on contact.

name: All-purpose glue
definition: general-purpose glue for household and building repairs.

name: Wood glue
definition: adhesive made to bond wood (PVA and others).

name: Wallpaper adhesive
definition: paste for hanging wallpaper.

name: Tile adhesive
definition: Adhesive for fixing wall and floor tiles.

name: Sealant
definition: flexible compound that seals joints and gaps against water and air.

name: Tile grout
definition: Compound that fills the joints between tiles.

name: AA battery
definition: Cylindrical battery of IEC size R6.

name: AAA battery
definition: Cylindrical battery of IEC size R03.

name: C battery
definition: Cylindrical battery of IEC size R14.

name: D battery
definition: Cylindrical battery of IEC size R20.

name: CR123A battery
definition: 3 V lithium cylindrical battery used in lights and cameras.

name: 18650 battery
definition: Lithium-ion cylindrical battery 18 mm by 65 mm, sold loose.

name: 21700 battery
definition: Lithium-ion cylindrical battery 21 mm by 70 mm, sold loose.

name: Coin cell
definition: Flat button or coin cell. Sizes such as CR2032 are all listed here.

name: 9 V battery
definition: Rectangular 9 V battery with snap terminals.

name: Battery charger
definition: Charger for loose standard cells such as AA, AAA and 18650.

name: LPG cylinder
definition: Refillable propane or butane bottle, owned or leased. The gas type and valve type are listed on the product.

name: Gas canister
definition: Small disposable gas canister for stoves, torches and lighters.

name: Firewood logs
definition: Split logs sold for burning, kiln-dried or not.

name: Kindling
definition: small dry sticks for starting a fire.

name: Coal
definition: coal or manufactured smokeless fuel sold in bags.

name: Charcoal briquettes
definition: moulded briquettes of compressed charcoal for barbecues.

name: Lump charcoal
definition: natural lumpwood charcoal (binchotan included).

name: Wood pellets
definition: compressed wood pellets for pellet grills, stoves and boilers.

name: Smoking chips and chunks
definition: wood chips or chunks for smoking food, by wood species.

name: Lubricant
definition: general oil, grease or penetrating lubricant sold in a can or tube.

name: Lighter fluid
definition: liquid fuel for refilling lighters or lighting barbecues.

name: Fuel can
definition: container made to carry and store fuel.

name: Firelighter
definition: block, cube or bag of fuel made to start a fire.

name: Match
definition: safety or strike-anywhere match.

name: Utility lighter
definition: Long-nozzle lighter for barbecues, stoves and fires. Pocket lighters are in Smoking & Vaping.

name: Candle lighter
definition: long lighter made to light candles.

name: Lighter flint
definition: replacement flint for a lighter (K-166).

name: Parcel tape
definition: wide adhesive tape for sealing parcels and boxes.

name: Bubble wrap
definition: plastic sheet of air bubbles for cushioning goods.

name: Stretch film
definition: clinging plastic film wound round goods or pallets.

name: Void fill
definition: loose fill, paper or air pillows packed round goods in a box.

name: Packing box
definition: Cardboard box sold flat for packing or moving. Boxes made for storing things are in Furniture & Storage.

name: Lintel
definition: beam of steel, concrete or timber set over a door or window opening to carry the wall above.

name: Roof tile
definition: clay, concrete or slate unit laid in overlapping courses as a roof covering (slates included).

name: Roof shingle
definition: strip of bitumen felt or wood laid in overlapping courses as a roof covering (shed and garden-building roofs).

name: Roofing felt
definition: roll of bitumen felt or synthetic membrane laid as a roof covering or underlay.

name: Draught excluder
definition: foam, rubber or brush strip or seal fitted round a door or window to stop draughts.

name: Garden sleeper
definition: heavy timber or composite beam sold loose for edging, steps and landscaping.

name: Gravel board
definition: concrete or timber board fixed at the foot of a fence panel to keep it off the ground.

name: Garage door
definition: up-and-over, roller, sectional or side-hinged door made for a garage opening.

name: Door frame
definition: Frame or lining set sold for hanging a door in an opening.

name: Roof window
definition: window made to be fitted in the slope or flat of a roof (flat-roof windows included).

name: Coach screw
definition: heavy hexagon-head wood screw driven with a spanner for structural timber fixings.

name: Self-tapping screw
definition: screw that forms its own thread in a pre-drilled hole in sheet metal or plastic (no drill point).

name: Jointing biscuit
definition: compressed wooden wafer glued into matching slots to join two boards.

name: Door knocker
definition: hinged knocker and plate fixed to an outside door.

name: Conduit
definition: rigid or flexible tube through which mains cables are run.

name: Trunking
definition: surface channel with a clip-on lid that carries and hides cables.

name: Junction box
definition: enclosure in which mains cables are joined.

name: Cable tie
definition: plastic or metal strap with a ratchet that bundles or fixes cables.

name: Circuit breaker
definition: automatic switch for a consumer unit that breaks a circuit on overload or earth leakage (MCB, RCD, RCBO).

name: Plug adaptor
definition: plug-in unit that gives one socket-outlet two or more outlets or a different socket type.

name: Flexible hose
definition: braided flexible hose with fittings that connects a tap, cistern or appliance to the supply pipe.

name: Water hammer arrester
definition: device fitted in a supply pipe that absorbs pressure shocks (water hammer).

name: Soil and drain pipe
definition: large-bore pipe and fittings that carry waste from toilets and drains to the sewer, above or below ground.

name: Drainage channel
definition: surface channel with a grating that collects water from a drive, patio or floor.

name: Bath or shower screen
definition: fixed or hinged glass panel fitted to a bath edge or as a walk-in screen, without a full enclosure.

name: Shower wall panel
definition: waterproof panel that lines a shower or bath wall in place of tiles.

name: Wood preservative
definition: clear or tinted treatment that protects wood against rot, insects and weather.

name: Spray adhesive
definition: adhesive in an aerosol can sprayed onto sheets, fabrics or insulation.

name: Flooring adhesive
definition: adhesive for laying vinyl, wood or other floor coverings.

name: Contact adhesive
definition: adhesive spread on both surfaces that bond on contact once touch-dry.

name: Expanding foam
definition: polyurethane foam from a can or gun that expands to fill and seal gaps.

name: Duct tape
definition: strong cloth-backed adhesive tape for repairs and sealing.

name: Tape dispenser
definition: hand dispenser with a cutting edge that lays parcel tape on boxes.

name: Foam packing
definition: foam sheet, roll, corner or insert that cushions goods in transit.

name: Strapping
definition: plastic or steel band tensioned round boxes or pallets.

name: 6 V lantern battery
definition: Rectangular 6 V battery with spring or screw terminals.

name: A23 battery
definition: Small 12 V cylindrical alkaline battery used in remotes and key fobs.

name: LPG regulator
definition: valve fitted to a gas cylinder that lowers its pressure for an appliance, sold with or without hose.

name: Macadam
definition: bitumen-bound aggregate sold in bags to lay or repair paths and drives.

name: Coving
definition: moulding fixed where wall meets ceiling to finish the joint.

name: Wood flooring
definition: Solid or engineered wood boards laid as a floor.

name: Vinyl flooring
definition: vinyl planks, tiles or sheet laid as a floor (LVT, click or glue-down; sheet vinyl included).

name: Flooring underlay
definition: foam, fibre or cork layer laid under laminate, wood or vinyl flooring.

name: Sealed lead-acid battery
definition: General sealed lead-acid battery block sold loose, in 6 V and 12 V.
